run_set_cuda_devices: run the set_cuda_devices_for_ci script to print the CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES value for a given test folder
test_cohere_test_folder: test the script with --test_folder models/cohere to get CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES set to 0,1,2,3
test_default_cuda_device: test the script without --test_folder to get CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES defaulting to 0
test_env_cuda_devices: test the script with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES in the environment to return the env variable value
summarize_set_cuda_devices: summarize the set_cuda_devices_for_ci script that sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES flexibly for GitHub Actions CI runners
